title: Fairway: A Way to Build Fair ML Software
benchmark_measurement: The paper cites an example of bias in a sentiment analyzer which gave a negative score to the sentence 'I am a Jew', illustrating how bias can manifest against religious identity.
findings: The paper does not present new findings on religion but cites a case where a Google sentiment analyzer demonstrated bias by assigning a negative score to the sentence 'I am a Jew' as a motivating example for the need for fairness in AI.
